## Participation pathways
Golden Forests presents direct company equity, selected plantation assets and strategic partnership opportunities. Separately, eligible investors may request an introduction to an independent licensed fund manager where available. Any fund is offered, managed and documented solely by that manager under its own permissions and approved materials. This website does not offer fund units. A company shareholding, a direct asset ownership arrangement and a fund interest have distinct rights and economics.

## Illustrative crop economics
The separate Philippine crop-economics page presents modeled crop-linked participant receipts under assumed allocations, costs and commissions. These are not company-wide profits, shareholder dividends or fund performance. No participation pathway automatically conveys the modeled receipts. Entitlement to proceeds, deductions, fees, governance and distributions must be established in the selected opportunity’s definitive agreements. Company revenues are not automatically payable to shareholders.

IRRs reflect modeled cash-flow timing and are not assured annual payouts. The mango IRR is presented as approximately 20%, rounded from the last supplied precise model. Returns and proceeds are illustrative, before participant-specific taxes and not guaranteed. They do not apply to Thailand opportunities. Review the current dated financial model and final transaction documents with independent advisers.

## Purpose of this website
This website provides general information about Golden Forests operating businesses and plantation activities. It does not provide investment, financial, legal or tax advice. Website content alone is not an offer or a commitment to issue shares or enter into a transaction.

## Direct company investment
Any direct equity transaction is an investment in the identified issuing company. A company share does not confer direct ownership of specific trees, planting blocks, land or other plantation assets. The identity of the issuer, share class, rights, price and transaction terms must be established in the relevant documents before any commitment.

## Eligibility and governing documents
Availability, eligibility, minimum investment and jurisdictional restrictions depend on the actual transaction and applicable law. Review the subscription and constitutional documents, share terms, risk disclosures, financial information and any relevant fee arrangements. Definitive transaction documents govern the transaction and prevail over summaries on this website. An enquiry does not constitute a subscription or acceptance.

## Investment risks
- Loss of some or all invested capital.
- No guarantee of returns, dividends, distributions, capital appreciation or repayment.
- Illiquidity, transfer restrictions, long investment horizons and potentially no secondary market.
- Agricultural, biological, weather, fire, pest, disease and natural-disaster risks.
- Operational, management, market, commodity-price, logistics and counterparty risks.
- Land-title, land-use, permitting, regulatory, political and legal risks.
- Currency, taxation and cross-border investment risks.
- Valuation uncertainty and delays in development, harvesting, sales or exits.
- Concentration and private-company risks, including insolvency.

## Business revenues and shareholder outcomes
Harvest proceeds belong to the relevant business and are not automatically payable to shareholders. Any dividends depend on company performance, available cash, reserves, share rights and applicable law. Plantation records and inspections do not guarantee asset value, title, liquidity or investor returns.

## Forward-looking and environmental statements
Plans, forecasts and illustrative operating timelines depend on assumptions and actual conditions. They are not guarantees of future results. Environmental objectives, including biodiversity and carbon-related outcomes, require implementation, measurement and verification. No certified carbon credits or certification status should be inferred from an objective or estimate.

## Reporting and third parties
Company financial reports, plantation inspections and independent audits serve different purposes. Their availability and scope must be confirmed in the relevant company arrangements. References to research, technical or operational partners do not imply their endorsement of an investment or a guarantee of its results.

## Independent advice
Prospective investors should assess their circumstances, liquidity needs, risk tolerance and investment horizon and obtain independent advice from appropriately qualified financial, legal, tax and accounting professionals. Do not act on this website where doing so would breach applicable law. Accessing this website does not create an advisory relationship, an investment commitment or a waiver of legal rights.
